title: ChiMesh part
description: One row of the ChiMesh build parts catalog. The CANONICAL data lives in /config/parts.json (contractual shape consumed by MindAttic.Deploy/src/parts.js). This schema documents the per-part entity shape so codex doctor can validate it. Stable id = part.<slug>.

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the catalog (e.g. rak4631, tp5000-lfp).

category.description: core = one per node (counted in per-node total); consumable = shared kit; tools = one-time, excluded from total.

inTotal.description: Whether the price counts toward the per-node build total. Defaults true for core; explicitly false for consumable/tools.

imageFile.description: Relative path under config/ to the part image.
